claim: Most meetings need no physical co-location
originalWording: Most meetings need no physical co-location

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Most ordinary information-sharing meetings can be conducted without co-location; the wording is about need, not actual venue share.
reference.rationale: Large-scale video and collaboration platforms already supported ordinary distributed meetings by 2019. The capability remains established. It would misread this claim to require proof that most meetings actually happened online.
